wa_mount_constance_north_chute.primary: Lake Constance climbers' trail, then up Avalanche Canyon past the South Chute

why.Dosewallips road and Constance Pass, ove: To skip the steep Lake Constance climbers' trail and enter upper Avalanche Canyon from above, at the price of a much longer road walk and cross-country travel over Crystal Pass.

wa_mount_daniel_lynch_glacier.primary: Cathedral Pass and Peggy's Pond, then the east ridge and Lynch draw

why.Deception Pass, Marmot and Jade Lakes, a: When coming from the east or linking the climb with Dip Top and Lynch Peak, accepting a longer walk than the Peggy's Pond approach; best early, before the moat opens.

wa_mount_ellinor_standard.primary: Upper Trailhead on NFR 24, Trail #812 summer route

why.Lower Trailhead, the long approach to th: When the road to the upper lot is snowed in or gated; longer but gentler, joining the same trail about 1,000 ft up.
why.The winter chute, direct from the timber: Outside summer, while snow buries the upper switchbacks and the chute holds firm snow; needs an axe and traction and carries real avalanche risk.

wa_mount_fernow_southeast_face.primary: Phelps Creek and Leroy Basin, over the col and across the Gloomy Glacier

why.Holden Village and Copper Basin: When you can take the Lake Chelan boat to Holden; it reaches the standard east-side line more directly and can be done in a day from the village.
why.Entiat River from Cottonwood: For a long, mostly trail approach with less gain and little avalanche exposure, when the Phelps Creek approach is in avalanche condition or you are making a longer trip.

wa_mount_fricaba_standard.primary: Upper Dungeness Trail to Home Lake and Constance Pass

why.Royal Basin and the Royal-Deception divi: When combining Fricaba with Mystery, Deception or Hal Foss, camping at Royal Lake and crossing a snowfield to the divide, rather than the longer walk to Home Lake.

wa_mount_hopper_standard.primary: Staircase and the North Fork Skokomish to First Divide

why.First Divide from the Duckabush and Marm: When coming from the Duckabush side as a longer multi-day trip with a night at Marmot Lake, once the closed trail to First Divide reopens.

wa_mount_howard_south_slope.primary: Merritt Lake Trailhead and Nason Ridge Trail to Crescent Lake

why.Rock Mountain Trailhead via Rock Lake an: When also climbing Rock Mountain, running a car-shuttle traverse, or when the rough road to Merritt Lake is impassable; longer, with a descent to Crescent Lake that must be regained.

wa_mount_lago_south_slope_south_face.primary: From Slate Pass down the Middle Fork Pasayten

why.From Robinson Creek over Robinson Pass: When starting from the low Robinson Creek trailhead instead of the high start at Slate Pass; a much longer walk that reaches the same Pasayten camps.

why.Thunder Creek and Fisher Creek: When Easy Pass is still snowbound or a party would rather not climb the steep pass; a longer all-trail walk from Colonial Creek, usually spread over several days.

wa_mount_maude_r1.primary: Phelps Creek and Leroy Basin to the Seven Fingered Jack / Maude col

why.Entiat River and Ice Lakes from the east: For parties already camped at Ice Lakes or exiting that way; a far longer walk than Leroy Basin, but it reaches the face from the east without a bushwhack.
